question.zh-CN: 怎样把实验样机变成可制造、可维护且配置明确的交付物？
question.en: How can prototypes become manufacturable, serviceable deliverables with explicit configurations?

problem.zh-CN: 实现强度、重量与尺寸要求。
problem.en: Meet strength, weight and dimensional requirements.

research.zh-CN: 轻量结构、材料设计与拓扑优化。
research.en: Lightweight structures, materials design and topology optimization.

industry.zh-CN: 加工能力、表面处理与公差控制。
industry.en: Process capability, finishing and tolerance control.

compare.zh-CN: 质量、公差、疲劳与材料批次。
compare.en: Mass, tolerances, fatigue and material batches.

problem.zh-CN: 缩短设计验证与样件制造周期。
problem.en: Shorten design validation and prototype fabrication cycles.

research.zh-CN: 复杂结构、柔性器件与多材料设计。
research.en: Complex structures, compliant devices and multi-material design.

industry.zh-CN: 工艺选择、后处理与一致性。

compare.zh-CN: 样件周期、强度方向性与返工率。
compare.en: Prototype lead time, strength anisotropy and rework rate.

research.zh-CN: 自动标定、参数辨识与误差传播。
research.en: Automated calibration, identification and error propagation.

industry.zh-CN: 装配工艺、检测工装与可追溯记录。
industry.en: Assembly processes, test fixtures and traceable records.

compare.zh-CN: 标定残差、合格率与一致性。

problem.zh-CN: 控制部件变化及其系统影响。
problem.en: Control component changes and system consequences.

research.zh-CN: 可替代设计与模块化架构。

industry.zh-CN: 物料清单、替代件、版本与交期。
industry.en: Bills of materials, alternatives, versions and lead times.

compare.zh-CN: 配置可追溯性、替代验证与维护兼容。
compare.en: Configuration traceability, substitution validation and service compatibility.

problem.zh-CN: 把机器人接入真实业务流程。
problem.en: Integrate robots into actual business workflows.

research.zh-CN: 任务建模、人机协作与混合自动化。
research.en: Task modeling, human-robot cooperation and hybrid automation.

industry.zh-CN: 工装、现场接口、调试与验收。
industry.en: Tooling, site interfaces, commissioning and acceptance.

compare.zh-CN: 改造时间、稳定节拍与异常处理。
compare.en: Retrofit time, stable cycle time and exception handling.

problem.zh-CN: 保持设备与人员长期可用。
problem.en: Maintain equipment and workforce readiness over time.

research.zh-CN: 预测维护、维修性设计与技能迁移。
research.en: Predictive maintenance, serviceability design and skill transfer.

industry.zh-CN: 备件、培训、维修流程与版本支持。
industry.en: Spares, training, repair procedures and version support.

compare.zh-CN: 维修时间、维护成本与支持周期。
compare.en: Repair time, maintenance cost and support period.
